finite_shot.header:
\begin{table*}%[t]
\caption{Finite-shot resources per ground-state energy estimate for $^{6}$He and $^{22}$O using ideal circuits.
Size counts phase qubits for QPE, nonzero sampling times for ODMD, and basis states for QKrylov.
For each nucleus and method, Shots/setting gives the number of repetitions
chosen for each circuit before validation.
The number of circuit executions per estimate (Total shots) equals the number of
distinct circuits (Settings) times the shots per setting.
For QPE we return the sample lower quartile, chosen because the 25th percentile of
each calibrated readout distribution lies within the target energy window.
QKrylov uses greedy Majorana pairing.
Each interval $\delta t$ comprises $r=4$ first-order Trotter substeps.
Max.\ substeps counts sequential substeps in the longest circuit.
$W$ counts time-evolution Pauli rotations over all shots, with weight one for uncontrolled rotations
and two for controlled rotations. The ratio $W/W_{\rm QPE}$ uses QPE for the same nucleus as its reference.
Success gives the number of estimates within $100$~keV of the exact ground-state energy in 1,200 independent trials per row
(target success probability $95\%$).}
\label{tab:r21_fixed_sampling}
\begin{ruledtabular}
\begin{tabular}{llrrrrrrrr}
Nucleus & Method & Size & $\delta t$ ($\mathrm{MeV}^{-1}$) & Settings & Shots/setting & Total shots & Max.\ substeps & $W/W_{\rm QPE}$ & Success \\
\hline
